title: Die Hard with a Vengeance
tagline: One very long day in New York. Snacks for the road.
about: John McClane and a Harlem shopkeeper race around the city solving a bomber's riddles.

    StartersBeef PattyCurried chuck and onion in golden turmeric pastry.Grabbed between riddles.How to make it1 brown onion, finely diced2 tbsp vegetable oil400g beef mince2 tsp mild curry powder1 tsp dried thyme1 tsp salt125ml beef stock30g dry breadcrumbs4 sheets of frozen shortcrust pastry1 tsp ground turmeric1 egg, beaten1 bottle hot sauceSoften the onion in the oil, then brown the mince with the curry powder, thyme and salt.Add the stock and simmer until almost dry, then stir in the breadcrumbs and cool.Heat the oven to 200°C. Brush the pastry sheets with turmeric mixed into the beaten egg and cut two 12cm rounds from each.Spoon the filling onto half of each round, fold over and crimp with a fork. Brush the tops with the rest of the egg.Bake on lined trays until golden and flaky, about 25 minutes. Serve hot with hot sauce.Bacon, Egg & CheeseCrisp strips, fried yolk, American, on a toasted buttered kaiser.Ketchup on the side. Wrapped to go in a minute.How to make it8 rashers of bacon4 eggs4 slices of American cheese4 kaiser rolls20g butter3 tbsp tomato saucesalt and pepper, to tasteFry the bacon until crisp.Fry the eggs in the same pan, breaking the yolks, and lay a slice of cheese on each to melt.Split, butter and toast the rolls. Fill with bacon and egg, season and add tomato sauce.MainsChicken & WafflesButtermilk thighs fried crisp, butter and hot sauce honey.The house plate, served all day.How to make it600g boneless chicken thighs300ml buttermilk1 tsp salt200g plain flour1 tsp sweet paprika300g waffle mix100ml honey2 tsp hot sauce2 L vegetable oil, for fryingSoak the chicken in the buttermilk and salt.Soak in the fridge.Dredge in the flour mixed with paprika and make the waffle batter.Fry the chicken in oil at 175°C in batches until at least 74°C inside.Cook the waffles in a waffle iron. Warm the honey with the hot sauce and drizzle over the chicken on the waffles.SweetsCaramel SquaresBrown sugar caramel, salted peanuts, milk chocolate, coarse salt.Cut fresh at the counter every morning.How to make it200g brown sugar100g butter150ml thickened cream2 tbsp golden syrup200g roasted salted peanuts150g milk chocolateflaky sea salt, to tasteLine a 20cm square tin. Heat the sugar, butter, cream and golden syrup, stirring, then boil to 118°C.Stir in the peanuts and pour into the tin.Cool.Spread with melted chocolate and sprinkle with flaky salt.Chill, then cut into squares.DrinksFresh LemonadeSqueezed lemons, sugar syrup, cold water, over ice.By the jug for parties, 3 or 5 gallons.How to make it300g caster sugar300ml hot water400ml lemon juice3.4 L cold water1kg iceDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.Juice about 10 lemons.Chill the syrup, add the lemon juice and top up with cold water to exactly 4 litres. Serve over ice.
